summary.name: VideoDubber
summary.one_liner: A web-based AI service for translating videos into 150+ languages with voice cloning, lip sync, subtitles and dubbing.
use_cases: translating marketing videos into new markets
dubbing educational content into other languages
generating SRT or VTT subtitles for videos
automating video localization through an API
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes AI video translation with dubbing, voice cloning (including a premium tier), and frame-by-frame lip sync across 150+ languages. Users can edit scripts and timing in an editor, re-translate lines, swap voices, and set a glossary or custom translation prompts. Output options include SRT/VTT subtitle downloads and exported dubbed MP4 files. A REST API offers translate, dub, lipsync and job-status endpoints, and the service is listed on AWS Marketplace.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
